summary: Quality gates are implemented for this Markdown skill repository through validator tests, a standard-library repository validator, local Git hook templates, a hook installer, and GitHub Actions.

checks.expectation: Repository has an executable validation command.
checks.evidence: scripts/validate-playbook.py validates frontmatter, skill index, bootstrap contract, markdown links, worktree flag contract, and whitespace.
checks.remediation: Run python3 scripts/validate-playbook.py locally and in continuous integration.

checks.expectation: Local pre-commit, pre-push, and commit-message gates exist without requiring Node tooling.
checks.gap: Contributors must install hooks once per clone.

checks.expectation: Pull requests and pushes rerun validation on a clean checkout.
checks.remediation: Watch the Validate playbook workflow on the pull request.

checks.expectation: Commit subjects are machine-parseable Conventional Commits.
checks.evidence: scripts/validate-commit-message.py and scripts/git-hooks/commit-msg enforce allowed types.
checks.gap: GitHub Actions does not yet check pull request titles.
checks.remediation: Optional follow-up: add pull request title validation.

checks.expectation: Validator behavior has direct tests and CI runs them.
checks.evidence: tests/test_validate_playbook.py covers frontmatter parsing, valid repository acceptance, missing sections, standalone worktree rejection, hidden --target rejection, code-fence link ignoring, and current-repository CLI acceptance.

checks.expectation: Local hook installation does not silently destroy contributor hooks and works from linked worktrees.
checks.evidence: scripts/install-git-hooks.py resolves hooks with git rev-parse --git-path hooks, refuses to overwrite different existing hooks unless --force is passed, and writes a .architect-playbook-backup copy before replacement.
checks.remediation: Run python3 scripts/install-git-hooks.py; use --force only after reviewing existing hooks.
